Sanitized failure diagnostics merged via #4363 expose x-lovebud-error-stage / x-lovebud-error-class / x-lovebud-sqlstate on the query-failed 500 path. The actual live Pages Production database identity remains UNRESOLVED (secret_text bindings unreadable); the existing tree_comments SELECT GRANT is intentionally NOT revoked merely because the Pages runtime may target a different database.
